test_title: PYST 9: RRB Group D - Reasoning (Held On: 01 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

A + B means ‘A is the sister of B’,

A @ B means ‘A is the brother of B’,

A - B means ‘A is the wife of B’,

and A # B means ‘A is the father of B’.

How is O related to V if ‘O @ P + T - G # V’?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53ef41d53579a92635cb4da4d0e54822abd239e5a6cd17a40f2d65de6452254e.png] 

**Decoding the symbols:**

 
 

 **Symbol**
 **Meaning**
 
 

 A + B
 A is the **sister** of B
 
 

 A @ B
 A is the **brother** of B
 
 

 A − B
 A is the **wife** of B
 
 

 A # B
 A is the **father** of B
 
 

**Given expression:**

O @ P + T − G # V

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c6fbc8a97b762052d3d7b67fd10d156e223559abdfd9057ff69a7f03d1e38ad3.png] 

 

So O is the **brother of V’s mother**.

**Therefore, O is V’s Mother’s brother.**

**Hence, the correct answer is Option (4) .**
